skill.name: compound-docs
skill.description: Capture confirmed engineering fixes as structured, searchable solution documentation with schema validation and pattern detection.
skill.summary: Turns solved technical problems into reusable solution notes and recurring issue patterns.
skill.author: Bind

security_audit.summary: Most static detections are Markdown backticks, code fences, slash-command references, or documentation examples rather than executable code. No prompt injection or credential exfiltration intent was found, but the workflow should validate constructed documentation paths before writing files.

remediation.suggestion: Normalize output_dir, category, and filename before writing. Reject absolute paths, parent-directory segments, empty segments, and shell metacharacters.
Prefer direct filesystem APIs or explicitly quoted arguments for mkdir and search examples. Keep all operations inside the configured documentation directory.

content.value_statement: Solved engineering problems often disappear into chat history. Compound Docs turns confirmed fixes into structured, searchable solution notes.
actual_capabilities: Detects phrases that indicate a technical fix worked.
Prompts for missing symptom, category, root cause, and prevention details.
Searches existing solution documents for related issues before creating new notes.
Creates categorized Markdown solution documents in a configured output directory.
Promotes recurring issues into patterns.md after user confirmation.
limitations: Requires enough conversation context to identify the solved problem.
Asks follow-up questions when critical documentation details are missing.
Depends on repository write access to create or update solution files.
New categories and path values need validation before use.

use_cases.title: Capture Fixes After Debugging
use_cases.description: Turn a confirmed fix into a reusable solution note before the context is lost.

use_cases.title: Build a Team Knowledge Base
use_cases.description: Standardize solved issue records across categories, symptoms, causes, and prevention steps.

use_cases.title: Find Repeated Operational Issues
use_cases.description: Detect recurring deployment, integration, testing, or performance problems and promote them to patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Document a Recent Fix
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: capture one solved issue from the current conversation.
prompt_templates.prompt: That worked. Use compound-docs to document the issue, the solution, and how to prevent it next time.

prompt_templates.title: Add Missing Context
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: improve a solution note with root cause and symptoms.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use compound-docs for this fix. Ask me for any missing symptom, category, root cause, or prevention details before writing the note.

prompt_templates.title: Check for Related Issues
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the compound-docs workflow and search existing solution notes for related issues before creating a new document.

prompt_templates.title: Promote a Recurring Pattern
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: convert repeated incidents into a documented pattern.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use compound-docs to compare this solved issue with existing notes. If it has occurred more than once, ask whether to add it to patterns.md.

output_examples.input: That worked. The deployment failed because the image tag pointed at an old build.
output_examples.output: Creates a deployment solution note with symptoms, root cause, the working fix, and prevention guidance for image tagging.

output_examples.input: The same API timeout issue happened again after the retry setting was removed.
output_examples.output: Finds related integration notes, asks for confirmation, and prepares a recurring pattern entry for future reviews.

output_examples.input: This testing failure was caused by a missing mock for the payment client.
output_examples.output: Records the test symptom, affected component, root cause, and prevention step in the testing documentation area.

best_practices: Use the skill immediately after confirming a fix worked.
Provide exact symptoms, error messages, and the final working solution.
Review related issue suggestions before creating a new note.
anti_patterns: Do not document trivial typos or obvious one-line mistakes.
Do not create new categories when an existing schema value fits.
Do not write notes without enough root cause or prevention context.

faq.question: When does Compound Docs run?
faq.answer: It runs when a solved-problem phrase appears or when the user invokes the compound command.

faq.question: What files does it create?
faq.answer: It creates Markdown solution notes and may update patterns.md when repeated issues are confirmed.

faq.question: Does it require a specific technology stack?
faq.answer: No. The schema uses broad categories and can add project-specific values when needed.

faq.question: Can it prevent duplicate documentation?
faq.answer: It searches existing notes by keyword, file path, and dependency references before creating a new note.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the symptom, final fix, affected component, root cause, and any prevention step you know.

faq.question: Is it safe to add new categories?
faq.answer: New categories are useful, but they should be simple path-safe names before files or folders are created.
